intent: Climb each identified hill family through a measured, semantically qualified experiment; finish each as kept, rejected, or limited by an explicit proof/API constraint. No universal performance ceiling claim.
acceptance: Build and qualify before timing; serialize timing against our builds/tests/rendering/packaging. Fresh confirmation pairs for promising screens; investigate >3% regressions and preserve rejected variants. Refresh all README plots and dated provenance for delivered batches.

items.title: Minimal AOT runtime and static full linking
items.conclusion: Official full SDK static linking with section collection and static C++ runtimes reproduces measured host40bb4d. Ordinary and AOT retained; no Rust build required. Runtime-only shared source build and AOT-only static variants retained as rejected alternatives. Minimal SDK failed GC/EH compatibility.

items.title: Direct import binding
items.conclusion: Direct binding did not establish a useful broad process-time gain in the representative10-example screens/combined holdout. Linker cost is a small part of measured startup.

items.title: Callback copies and memory-handle lookup
items.conclusion: Copy-free callbacks and memory-handle caching did not earn extra code in the cold-process workload screens. Callback-heavy throughput remains a different workload, not a claimed limit.

items.title: Typed unchecked callback trampolines
items.conclusion: Exact-signature raw callbacks passed ABI tests but the9-round process screen showed only1.018 geometric AOT speedup. Added ABI maintenance is unjustified by this workload.

items.title: Host optimization flags and LTO
items.conclusion: O3/LTO/native host flag screen did not show a compelling broad gain. Keep the measured portable O2 host command.

items.title: Engine initialization controls
items.conclusion: No-COW ordinary screen was unchanged and unchanged AOT artifacts reject its altered tunable. No-growth reservation screen was weak. Bounds checks and proposal support retained.

items.title: Unused loop ordinals
items.conclusion: Remove unused ordinal locals and arithmetic. Nine example modules shrink; noisy process timings do not establish a runtime speedup.

items.title: Redundant zero stores
items.conclusion: Elide duplicate exact integer-zero stores only before any effectful initializer; full zero fill and initializer evaluation remain. Foreign initializer memory edits retain ordered stores.

items.title: Print snapshots and scratch bookkeeping
items.conclusion: Print watermarks preserve callback reentry after a caught trap; mutable Text snapshots also prevent unsafe pooling. Unsafe proposal was not applied or benchmarked. Permanent reentry regression retained.

items.title: Wider fills and bounded copies
items.conclusion: Checked wider zero fills and bounded forward-equivalent copies preserve scalar fallbacks for overlap, partial writes, invalid logical/physical spans. Synthetic u32 repeat probes improve about11x on Wasmtime; examples remain separately measured.

items.title: Bounded literal-range unrolling
items.conclusion: Bounded signed literal ranges use exact unrolling under a small expansion budget. Nine paired warmed Life rounds confirm1.747x speedup, MAD.0206; native gap remains.

items.title: Grouped descending-loop lower-bound guard
items.conclusion: Grouped descending lower-bound guard retains ordered comparisons and scalar tail.15 warmed Sorting pairs confirm1.332x(MAD.007); Sudoku also improves.

items.title: Tiny popcount and expression calls
items.conclusion: Recognize complete pure unsigned-popcount wrappers, preserving formal truncation/debug behavior. Adds1.086x(MAD.006) warmed Sudoku gain; wrapper body remains emitted.

items.title: Deferred hash lane write-back
items.conclusion: Standalone deferred scalar lane stores regressed hash about6.9%. Retain only as the guarded SIMD foundation; unsupported bodies keep the original write-through loop.

items.title: Blocked hash SIMD
items.conclusion: Generic blocked u32 recurrence SIMD passed lane/alias/trap/cast/tail checks and complete qualification. Earlier Wasmtime hash9-pair confirmation was2.890x overH13; fresh delivered baseline/final9-pair ratios are2.78650x Wasmtime and3.63675x defaultV8. These are batch results, not a universal ceiling.

items.title: Affine Life stencil SIMD
items.conclusion: Safe affine stencil extraction is absent: toroidal boundaries, arbitrary byte sums up to2040, tiny dimensions, aliasing and exact partial-write semantics need a larger legality analysis. This is an open engineering hill, not a Wasmtime ceiling.

items.title: Packed CRC basis terms
items.conclusion: Packed immutable CRC basis lookup is correct but15pairs regress on both engines: baseline/candidate .682 Wasmtime and .712 V8. Reverted; source/tests/compiler/results retained.

items.title: Binaryen pass isolation and emitter simplification
items.conclusion: Normal-semantics Binaryen local-pass/O3 sweep completed without adding a default tier. The earlier9-round all-workload sweep retained gains and regressions; delivered15-pair Life raw/O3 was1.83981x. Standard SIMD feature permission in the optional reference helper was separately corrected and qualified without changing compiler or raw measurements.

items.title: Conditional block resource bookkeeping
items.conclusion: Conservative per-block RegionNext omission passed65focused gates and the full differential/host replay. Borrowed typed numeric views are recognized; allocating, addressed, captured, nonlocal and unknown-call scopes retain their protections. No independent speedup is attributed.

items.title: Private binding array-layout specialization
items.conclusion: Private binding alone does not prove physical relayout unobservable through byte aliases or host memory inspection. No new representation optimizer; H15 specializes computation under explicit guards.

items.title: Sparse static reservations
items.conclusion: Logical static extent plus owned text fragments eliminates dense compiler zero images.34modules byte-identical. Synthetic256MiB logical global184.862->2.599ms; wait4 peak childRSS519.62->26.27MiB includes Python pre-exec floor.

items.title: Build invocation and existing worker overhead
items.conclusion: Avoid unused dependency content hashes when artifact validation/cache is disabled. No headline timing win claimed. Existing nativeCLI/worker avoid Python startup; no new daemon/cache added.

items.title: Qualification iteration costs
items.conclusion: Collect Python host package/timing metadata only when requested; public API default remains compatible.15 CPU2 pairs show1.184x without timing(MAD.012),1.0x with timing; ordinary affinity screen was noisy. Preserve fresh-process qualification.

items.title: Default V8 first-call code shape
items.conclusion: Exact integer-literal-arm selects passed correctness and were retained within the measured batch. Fresh defaultV8 all10 paired confirmation completed; no independent speedup is attributed to this change. Diagnostic tier traces never change engine budgets or supply headline timing.

notes: Finite measured campaign; not a universal optimum or native-parity promise.
All raw observations retained; rejected variants are not default code.
Final reporting/qualification and immutable evidence packaging pending.
